biotools.summary: BrainSpace is a software package used to analyze functional connectivity patterns in resting-state fMRI data, particularly focusing on psychosis spectrum disorders. It allows for the calculation of entropy-based measures of connectivity and investigates their relationships with cognitive performance and other neurobiological factors.
